rooms.title: Our apartments
rooms.subtitle: Six apartments in total: one family apartment with a terrace, three apartments with a terrace and two apartments without terraces. All apartments have a kitchenette, bathroom, coffee machine and free Wi-Fi.

items.title: Family apartment with terrace no. 1
items.description: Spacious and bright family apartments, suited to a comfortable stay for a family or a group of friends. There is a large, comfortable double bed and a sofa, so every guest sleeps well. If needed, extra beds can be added and up to six people can stay here. The special advantage of these apartments is the generous private terrace, where you can linger over morning coffee in the sun or spend peaceful evenings in the fresh air, warmed by the evening light. It makes for a pleasant atmosphere all day long. Guests have a fully equipped kitchenette and a bathroom with a shower and toilet. Thanks to the comfortable bed, a couple will feel especially at home here on a romantic break.

items.title: Apartment with terrace no. 2
items.description: Cosy apartments with a private terrace, a kitchenette and a bathroom with a shower and toilet. On the terrace you can enjoy a peaceful morning coffee and catch the first rays of the sun. In these apartments you can choose one double bed or two separate beds. With an extra bed added, up to three people can stay here.

items.title: Apartment no. 3
items.description: Quiet apartments with a kitchenette and a bathroom with a shower and toilet. The interior uses green tones, a cat on the wall lamp greets you, and the play of evening light makes the room romantic. Up to three people can stay. You can choose either separate beds or a double bed.

items.title: Apartment no. 4
items.description: Quiet, warm apartments with a kitchenette and a bathroom with a shower and toilet. The interior is designed in violet tones. Up to three people can stay. You can choose either separate beds or a double bed.

items.title: Apartment with terrace no. 5
items.description: Cosy apartments with a private terrace, a kitchenette and a bathroom with a shower and toilet. On the terrace you can enjoy the afternoon sun and watch the town. Up to three people can stay. You can choose either separate beds or a double bed.

items.title: Apartment with terrace no. 6
items.description: Cosy apartments with a private terrace, a kitchenette and a bathroom with a shower and toilet. The terrace opens onto a view of the town. On the terrace you can enjoy the afternoon sun. Up to two people can stay, and you can choose either separate beds or a double bed. This is our best-value offer, thanks to its compact size. For the same reason the kitchenette does not have a separate sink, but everything needed for cooking is there.

about.title: About us
about.description: The Hotel Mergera story — why Mērsrags, who we are and what inspired us.

hero.title: Small place. Heart project.
hero.subtitle: Hotel Mergera is a family-run guesthouse — our way of sharing the quiet of Mērsrags and the Latvian sauna tradition.

story.title: Our story
paragraphs: Mērsrags has always been more than a seaside town for us — it's the kind of quiet that lets you hear yourself again after long working months. When we got the chance to buy this house near the lighthouse, we knew: we wanted others to find the feeling we did.

Over the past few years we've reworked the house — natural materials, calm design, no clutter. The heart of it is the sauna and the hot tub, both open all year. When winter outside hits −10 °C, you'll find +40 °C in here.

history.title: From a long-held idea to a place people want to return to
history.imageAlt: Hotel Mergera opening moment with the hosts
paragraphs: Mergera did not begin as a quick project. It began with a thought about a house where people would step inside and feel warmth right away — not only from the stove or the sauna, but from the welcome, the scent of wood and the care in small details.
We wanted to keep the soul of the house while giving it a new life. Much of it came together by our own hands, with family and friends helping along the way, one careful step at a time.

That is why Hotel Mergera is not just a guesthouse for us. It is a place for simple things: a quiet morning, coffee and conversation, a hot sauna, children's laughter and the feeling that you are truly expected.
